title: Flight Mission Scheduling and Creation Workflow
content: To schedule a flight for an order: (1) Verify the order is in PENDING status in Order Management; (2) Use the Mission Planning Analyze tool to get AI route recommendations and energy predictions; (3) Select a suitable drone from Eligible Drones at the Origin Hub; (4) Create the Mission -> status transitions to SCHEDULED. You cannot schedule an order that already has an active mission.

title: Drone Flight Eligibility Requirements
content: A drone can only be assigned a mission when its status is AVAILABLE, it is stationed at the order's Origin Hub, and its maximum payload capacity (payload_capacity_kg) >= package weight. Drones in MAINTENANCE or IN_MISSION status cannot be assigned new missions.

title: Live Flight Tracking
content: The Live Tracking page updates drone positions every 3 seconds by polling /operator/missions/live-tracking. It displays GPS coordinates, altitude, speed, battery level, and intermediate Hubs passed. If a drone loses signal for more than 3 seconds, the system automatically creates an incident alert and notifies all Operators.

title: Incident Management
content: When an incident occurs: (1) Create an Incident Report with severity (Low/Medium/High); (2) If technical inspection is needed, set 'requires_technical_inspection=true' -> the system automatically creates a Maintenance Alert; (3) Track progress through OPEN -> INVESTIGATING -> CLOSED. High-severity incidents must be reported to Admin immediately.

title: AI Decision Center - Energy Prediction and Route Optimization
content: The AI Decision Center provides: (1) Flight energy consumption prediction (Wh) powered by a CatBoost model; (2) Optimal route analysis with recommended waypoints and best departure time; (3) Risk classification (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH) based on predicted energy; (4) SHAP analysis explaining why the AI made each recommendation. Use this to maximize operational efficiency.

title: Telemetry and Flight Data
content: Each mission records GPS coordinates (lat/lng), altitude (m), speed (m/s), battery voltage (V), energy consumed (Wh), and weather metrics (temperature, humidity, wind). Telemetry is pushed to the server in batches. Operators can review historical telemetry to analyze performance and compare actuals against AI predictions.

title: Order Approval and Cancellation Workflow
content: Operators can: (1) Create a Mission from a PENDING order; (2) Cancel an order when necessary (e.g., severe weather or no eligible drone available). Upon cancellation, the system automatically emails the customer. Only PENDING orders can be cancelled; orders with active flight missions must be handled via Incident workflows.

title: Hub Checkpoints and Route Verification
content: When a drone flies within 200m of an intermediate Hub, the system automatically logs a Hub Checkpoint containing the Hub name, actual coordinates, distance to Hub, and pass-through timestamp. The cooldown between checkpoints at the same Hub is 60 seconds. Used for journey tracking and post-incident recovery.
